product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT helps healthcare organizations extract, migrate, archive and manage clinical, financial and business data while keeping historical records secure and accessible.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes standard, enterprise and SaaS pricing models; a scoped quote is required rather than published numeric prices.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is healthcare data-management, product and industry content; no qualifying series of engineer-authored product-building posts was identified.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation or help-center link was found in the site navigation/footer. Public resources and a security trust center are not a product documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Readable openings include Data Conversion Interface Analyst, Systems Analyst, AWS DevOps Engineer and Associate Business Development Director; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named product model or provider was found in AI product pages, AI articles, security or privacy materials. The linked trust center could not be read, and no public subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims, not standalone certification attestations: the homepage displays HIPAA Compliant and the privacy policy explicitly claims GDPR compliance for EU/EEA residents. HITRUST is separately certified but is outside the requested five. No independent ISO 27001 or PCI DSS certification was substantiated.

last_funding.notes: Novacap significant investment announced November 28, 2023; amount was not publicly disclosed in these announcements.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent publicly announced investment found was November 28, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open business-development roles are Director/Associate Director titles, not SDR, BDR, representative or account executive titles under the requested definition.

launched_6mo.notes: Harmony Ignite product-introduction page is dated May 20, 2026 in publication metadata, within the window. It introduces archived-data contribution for de-identified longitudinal datasets supporting AI and research; this is dated product-page evidence rather than a separately titled press launch announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Announced May 12, 2026: Brian Liddell became CEO effective April 30, 2026, succeeding Tom Liddell, who transitioned to Chairman of the Board.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting explicitly describes using Sugar CRM and Definitive Healthcare. Salesforce is named as preferred prior CRM experience, not confirmed deployment; it is a hiring signal only.
